summary: The file-qualified cw_impact barrel-pinning regression has been correctly fixed in HEAD commit e73dfe5. The implementation in src/mcp/tools/impact.ts now uses plain traceImpact() for file-qualified targets (pinToExactSymbol=true) and preserves traceImpactWithBarrelAliases() only for unqualified name lookups. All relevant tests pass.

sharedStateObservations.observation: skillName backend-worker correctly assigned; worker session 0ac200ce verified the fix in a prior session.
sharedStateObservations.rationale: The feature's worker session ran before this scrutiny and confirmed the same fix state.

evidence: Commit e73dfe5 (fix(impact): keep file-qualified targets pinned) modifies src/mcp/tools/impact.ts lines 171-173 to use pinToExactSymbol conditional: traceImpact(db, pivot.id, maxDepth) when pinned, traceImpactWithBarrelAliases otherwise.

tests/integration/mcp-navigation-tools.test.ts line 152: test 'cw_impact keeps file-qualified targets pinned to the requested file' asserts target='impact-primary.ts:syncProfile' should contain 'runPrimarySync' and should NOT contain 'runBarrelSync'.

tests/unit/impact.test.ts: test 'keeps file:symbol targets pinned to the requested symbol in cw_impact' explicitly validates pinned behavior returns 'No dependents found' when the barrel alias has dependents but the file-qualified target does not.

tests/unit/impact.test.ts: test 'still merges same-directory barrel aliases for unqualified cw_impact targets' validates that unqualified 'useDataLayer' DOES include barrel-aliased dependents with the note about 2 symbols.
npx vitest run tests/integration/mcp-navigation-tools.test.ts: all 15 tests pass, including the pinning test (0ms).
npx vitest run tests/unit/impact.test.ts: all 18 tests pass, including both pinning and barrel-merge tests.
src/mcp/tools/impact.ts resolveTargetSymbols() correctly sets pinToExactSymbol=true when parsed.fileSuffix is present (file-qualified reference).
traceImpactWithBarrelAliases() (lines 73-105) correctly builds traceIds including barrel aliases, but is now only called when pinToExactSymbol=false.

The test fixture tests/fixtures/impact-primary.ts defines syncProfile() returning 'primary' and runPrimarySync() calling it. tests/fixtures/index.ts defines syncProfile() returning 'barrel' and runBarrelSync() calling it. These are intentionally parallel but distinct.
